colors.label: Colors

colorIdentity.hint: W, U, B, R, G; C for colorless. Use G,B for both colors; repeat the filter for either color.

legality.label: Legality
legality.hint: Format alone means legal. Optional status: legal, not_legal, restricted, banned.
